node_system.successors: a fixed duplicate-free enumeration of dyadic rationals in (0,1) not among the first 12
node_system.density: the full countable sequence is dense in (0,1)

stage.space: R^N_P direct_sum R^N_Q direct_sum R_M direct_sum R_J

transition.projection: pi_(M,N):T_M->T_N forgets P,Q samples with index >=N and retains M,J
transition.section: iota_(N,M) zero-pads new P,Q samples and retains M,J
transition.section_warning: zero-padding is coordinate bookkeeping, not source interpolation

covariance.completion_warning: compatible finite covariances do not alone produce a boundedly invertible covariance on an infinite completion

faithfulness.each_stage: faithful only on its declared 2N+2 retained coordinate record
faithfulness.finite_source_rank_bound: no T_N can be faithful on every source subspace of rank greater than 2N+2
faithfulness.inverse_limit_continuous_scalar_function: dense point values are injective on continuous P,Q functions if the inverse-limit element is known to arise from such functions
faithfulness.surjectivity_warning: an arbitrary compatible sample sequence need not extend to a continuous function
faithfulness.all_jet_warning: dense point values do not identify derivative jets without analytic or differential reconstruction data

response_compatibility.residual: the closing edge at stage M couples retained node 0 to a forgotten node, so pi K_M differs from K_N pi
response_compatibility.consequence: the coherent trace tower does not yet extend the finite response/Evans/RH chain

next_required_object.acceptance: declare K_N and transition maps with pi K_M=K_N pi, preserve the N=12 response or state its supersession, and prove covariance/Real/orientation compatibility
